title: Question 24
passage:
How often do you water the herbs on your kitchen windowsill?
A. I got the little pots from my neighbor. B. Usually twice a week, unless the soil’s still damp. C. The window gets a lot of afternoon sun.
passageZh:
你多久澆一次廚房窗台上的香草？
A. 這些小花盆是鄰居給我的。
B. 通常一週兩次，除非土還是濕的。
C. 那扇窗下午有很多陽光。
audioScript:
How often do you water the herbs on your kitchen windowsill?
A. I got the little pots from my neighbor. B. Usually twice a week, unless the soil’s still damp. C. The window gets a lot of afternoon sun.
